rows.reason: ApplicationInput joins per-seat bindings, focus/catchers, console/menu/chat routing and focus-loss held-control release to the common command input.

rows.title: Mouse filtering, sensitivity, inversion and command timing
rows.reason: The shared input builder applies actual mouse settings and produces source-relative usercmd angles and movement; authority and prediction use the same conversion.

rows.title: Joystick profiles, thresholds and device lifecycle
rows.reason: SDL controller routing works, but SourceInputState and its Linux/Windows legacy joystick/POV/ball profiles have no application caller.

rows.title: MIDI note input and device configuration
rows.reason: MIDI decoding/device helpers exist without an application-owned MIDI input lifecycle or selected-device configuration.

rows.title: Multiple local seats and remote participation
rows.reason: Multiple local seats have independent input/view/audio state, but local seats joining a remote Q3 match are not supported by the current Q2-only remote application.

rows.title: Per-seat gyro and tactile feedback
rows.reason: Accepted a8ace02 and 3e57748 join source BNVIB envelopes, affected-seat routing, lifecycle cancellation, shared enable/strength settings and runtime gain changes. Accepted 221547a and 27c17a9 add shared gyro calibration, device ownership and persisted gyro tuning. Haptic-settings persistence and physical-controller qualification remain unclaimed.

rows.title: Spatial sound channels and entity tracking
rows.reason: The consolidated UnifiedAudio mixer and application sound adapters implement source channel replacement, attenuation, spatialization and sound lifetime with real shared actors.

rows.title: Looping sounds and doppler
rows.reason: The consolidated loop-sound path preserves source entity loops, merge/reset/lifetime and Doppler behavior through the actual common audio mixer.

rows.title: Background intro/loop music and continuous gain
rows.reason: Actual world/cgame music supports intro/loop, pause, gain and replacement, but the specified menu/postgame music transitions are not joined with those missing product flows.

rows.title: Raw PCM, output formats and sound diagnostics
rows.reason: PCM ingestion/conversion and application soundinfo/soundlist/play diagnostics are connected. Accepted 0065d73b joins named/default device selection, persisted gains and device restart while retaining queued PCM timing and music. Output remains fixed at 44100 Hz, stereo, 16-bit; selectable output bits/channels/rate and the full source restart/cache workflow remain unqualified. Dummy SDL checks do not qualify physical buffering or audibility.

rows.title: Audio policy for multiple local listeners
rows.reason: The common mixer consumes per-seat listeners and routes shared world sound without duplicating global streams; the application updates actual seat listeners.

rows.title: Legacy A3D geometry behavior account
rows.reason: The common replacement samples room size/materials for reverb and underwater filtering, but it does not implement per-source geometry occlusion/obstruction required by the legacy A3D spatial contract. This is an implementation gap, independent of audible qualification.

rows.title: RoQ video and audio decoding
rows.reason: The source RoQ decoder implements chunk/codebook/VQ video and DPCM audio and is consumed by the application cinematic source.

rows.title: Cinematic timing, looping, hold and skip
rows.reason: Cgame cinematic slots play actual media, but the full standalone cinematic input/skip/end/nextmap transition workflow is not joined to Application.

rows.title: World material and menu cinematics
rows.reason: Menu cinematic slots are joined, but ApplicationAssets constructs SceneShaderRegistry without playCinematic, leaving world videoMap stages unresolved. CinematicImage also rejects dimension changes instead of resizing the resource.

rows.title: Timed subtitles and captions for supplied media
rows.reason: Caption data/settings helpers are present, but a complete source subtitle/caption event-to-visible-timeline application path is not established.

rows.title: Demo recording and legacy playback
rows.reason: Q3 demo codecs exist, but record/playback, snapshot consumption and demo UI/application lifecycle are not joined.

rows.title: Timedemo clocks and performance reporting
rows.reason: There is no joined application timedemo command, playback clock and performance-result workflow.

rows.title: Screenshots, levelshots and capture timing
rows.reason: Accepted fc0c15e implements automatic/named/silent screenshot commands, TGA/PNG/JPEG output, source-style 128x128 levelshot downsampling and complete-frame readback through the shared application capture path. Recording capture-clock integration with FPS/timescale and restart/timing behavior remains unfinished; screenshot and levelshot helper absence is no longer the gap.

rows.title: Console, history, completion and command scripts
rows.reason: Console editing/history, quoting and vstr/wait/echo are joined, but neither application Q3 CommandBuffer supplies readScript; exec therefore reports failure rather than reading the requested mounted script.

rows.title: Archived cvars, bindings and startup configuration
rows.reason: Frontend preferences persist and source cvars survive map changes, but archived source cvar/binding configuration, explicit writeconfig and product/profile startup migration are not fully joined.

rows.title: Runtime diagnostic and developer commands
rows.reason: Diagnostic primitives exist, but the complete source runtime diagnostic command set is not registered against the actual application owners.

rows.title: OmniTimer initialization, stamps and reporting
rows.reason: The required OmniTimer runtime/profiling contract has no established application implementation.

rows.title: Player sessions across map restarts
rows.reason: GameSessionManager captures source world/client session records, and Application carries them and userinfo through actual restart/map replacement.

rows.title: Complete unified world saves under Q3 gameplay
rows.reason: Application/shared save still rejects complete Q3 world restoration; session carry does not save entities, missiles, timers, objectives and bot runtime state.

rows.title: First/third-person, zoom and spectator camera behavior
rows.reason: The native cgame view path implements player view offsets, bob/kick/damage, third person and zoom while shared camera projection preserves foreign-source kick.

rows.title: Spline camera evaluation and timed camera events
rows.reason: Runtime camera splines and their source-authored load/control/interpolation lifecycle are not joined to the application view.

rows.title: Separate authoring and distribution application roles
rows.reason: Comparison documentation enumerates authoring/runtime roles, but complete runtime-derived obligations from all listed tool/SDK/archive inputs have not been established; this row cannot be completed from file inventory alone.

rows.title: Pause eligibility, command flood control and inactivity
rows.reason: Flood and inactivity policies run, but the application does not join source pause eligibility and paused Q3 server-frame handling required by this compound row.

rows.title: Independent prerelease demo product restrictions
rows.reason: Demo-product-specific restrictions and profile/UI behavior are not joined; actual network admission currently sets demoRestricted to false.

rows.title: Authored movers, triggers, targets and world entities
rows.reason: Actual mover, trigger, target, teleporter and portal source handlers are instantiated against shared bodies/callbacks and participate in native slot traversal.

rows.title: Q3 movement and source-time profile
rows.reason: The actual shared Q3 movement provider implements source command timing, movement modes, collision/step/slide, water/jump and weapon-event phases, with shared prediction using the same provider.

rows.title: Objective and spawn adaptation on foreign maps
rows.reason: Foreign-map ordinary movement/combat/bots work, but the application explicitly lacks complete objective-anchor/campaign adaptation for all Q3/TA modes on Q1/Q2 maps.
